name: The Westin Tempe
positioning: A downtown Tempe hotel steps from Arizona State University, with floor-to-ceiling mountain and city views and a rooftop pool and bar
best_for: Visitors to Arizona State University who want to stay steps from campus
Travelers who want a rooftop pool with views of Camelback Mountain and downtown

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Tempe, Arizona, just steps from Arizona State University.
Rooms have spa-centric bathrooms with rain showers and the Westin Heavenly Bed.
Upgraded deluxe rooms and suites include corner rooms with views of Camelback and A Mountain.
Private shaded rooftop cabanas can be rented, each with two chaise lounges, bottled water and food and drink service from Skysill.
Terra Tempe Kitchen and Spirits serves a revolving menu of Sonoran dishes from seasonal ingredients sourced through local farmers and artisans.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24 hours and has Peloton bikes.
Guests get complimentary bike rentals for two hours.
The Mill Avenue District is a 5-minute walk and A Mountain (Hayden Butte) an 8-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel hosts events such as rooftop DJ nights, seasonal pop-ups, wellness experiences and culinary events.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool has daybeds, lounge chairs and a hot tub, with views of downtown, Camelback Mountain and ASU Stadium.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views of Camelback Mountain, ASU Stadium and the city.
The Penthouse Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the mountain skyline, a living and entertainment space, a wet bar, a separate king bedroom and a deep soaking garden tub.
Skysill Rooftop Lounge is described as the highest rooftop bar in Tempe, with sweeping city views.

considerations.text: The hotel is cashless; it accepts major credit cards and mobile payments.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a desert resort feel.
